newsitem.title: UK: UK govt details plans for more private care homes.
newsitem.headline: UK govt details plans for more private care homes.

text.p: The British government plans to introduce a bill in the next session of parliament which will greatly expand the private nursing home sector, Health Secretary Stephen Dorrell said on Wednesday.
He said the bill would reduce the power of local authorities to provide such services.

"In respect of residential and domiciliary services for adults, the power (could) only be used when an authority can show that direct provision of service by the local authority is necessary to meet a need that cannot be met locally by the non-statutory sector," he said.
Labour health spokesman Chris Smith rejected the idea, saying the result of such a bill would be "enforced privatisation". -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7767
